mostWorthwhile.text: Opening and repairing the terminal was the most worthwhile passage: its identified faults made the cleaning and ribbon replacement feel purposeful, and powering it introduced Moth.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the repaired speaker to the music player was predictable, though it provided a pleasant payoff for Miro.

surprise.text: Moth's cached map treated the neighborhood as a service gap, suggesting that the missing address reflects a broader directory problem rather than a single handset error.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the terminal repair followed the faults revealed when its cover was opened.

continue.text: Yes. I would continue to see how the neighbors challenge the service gap; the repair work and Moth's response made that problem tangible.
